admission_rule: At least two non-vacuous weak assertions must miss the buggy RTL before admission.

candidates.expression: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) (m_axis_tvalid) |-> (m_axis_tdata == s_axis_tdata[select*DATA_WIDTH +: DATA_WIDTH]));
candidates.rationale: Checks only the current sample after a reduced trigger and cannot enforce the required cross-cycle history.

candidates.expression: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) (m_axis_tdata == s_axis_tdata[select*DATA_WIDTH +: DATA_WIDTH]) |-> !$isunknown(m_axis_tdata == s_axis_tdata[select*DATA_WIDTH +: DATA_WIDTH]));
candidates.rationale: Observes only that the final output is known when already asserted; it ignores how and when that output was reached.

candidates.expression: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready) |-> (m_axis_tdata == s_axis_tdata[select*DATA_WIDTH +: DATA_WIDTH]));
candidates.rationale: Removes the next-cycle or multi-cycle delay from the intended temporal relationship.

candidates.expression: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) 1'b1 |-> !$isunknown(m_axis_tdata == s_axis_tdata[select*DATA_WIDTH +: DATA_WIDTH]));
candidates.rationale: Drops the behavioral trigger and reduces the check to output definedness.
A generic signal-integrity invariant contains no ordering, exact delay, duration, or protocol condition.
